compatibility.admission_policy: Protocol 1.1 requires a new source revision, native plugin digest, R1 receipt, live acceptance receipt, server binary receipt, and exact compatibility entry. It inherits no authority from protocol 1.0.

coverage.announcement_caveat: The retained announcement window is never complete fortress history. History truncation produces partial coverage.

security_invariants: All three methods authenticate before inspecting world or report state.
Protocol 1.1 registers no mutation RPC methods.
No RunCommand, RunLua, keyboard, pause, dig, labor, military, teleport, checkpoint, restore, or arbitrary forwarding method exists.
Protocol 1.0 and 1.1 handshakes publish exact, generation-specific method manifests.
Announcement pages are bounded and use a frozen high-water mark.
The Rust client rejects malformed protobuf, duplicate fields, nonminimal varints, invalid UTF-8, generation drift, method-manifest drift, cursor drift, window drift, and noncanonical order.
A complete announcement window grants no capability and is not an effect receipt.
